subject.title: WhatsApp: Add support for querying message reactions

question: Should WhatsApp reaction support persist passive add/remove events for generic querying, and should those events remain hook-only or also enter agent sessions?
rationale: The source proves the capability is missing, but code alone cannot decide privacy, retention, session-routing, removal semantics, or whether unavailable remote history should be represented as locally observed history.

options.title: Stage passive storage and query
options.body: Define an access-controlled passive event, persist observed reaction state in SQLite, add generic querying, and leave agent-turn triggering to the separate opt-in feature.

options.title: Ship hook-only observation
options.body: Limit this issue to a plugin reaction hook through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79996 and track historical storage and querying separately.

options.title: Keep outbound-only scope
options.body: Retain the current outbound and approval-specific behavior and document that arbitrary WhatsApp reaction history is unsupported.

recommendation.title: Stage passive storage and query
recommendation.body: Define an access-controlled passive event, persist observed reaction state in SQLite, add generic querying, and leave agent-turn triggering to the separate opt-in feature.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the established WhatsApp owner boundary, channel action contract, and inbound routing behavior associated with this contributor's history.
